'''Yoda I Am Tamtel's Team Revised''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Yoda I Am]]
* '''Published:''' 16 January 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Tatooine: Jabba's Palace|SE-L-tatooinejabbaspalace.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Tatooine: Jabba's Palace
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTat Tatooine Jabba's Palace YodaIAm LS.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

It's only a fun deck, but it has high destiny and many weapons (many weapons + high destiny = killing)

The published list has 62 cards.

== Strategy ==

MY STRATEGY: Start draining at Jabba's Palace, if opponent want to initate battle there use Fallen Partal... and CRASH! I think a good idea is using VibroAxes, for example on Tamtel and Klattoinians (put Klatooinians on Jabba's Palace site, they'll be power 5).Use skiffs to react. Deploy A Gif to Artoo. Try to get as many characters as you can (Nar Shaddaa Wind Chimes, You Will Take Me To Jabba Now) and drain!
